name: Ussher (1650)
description: James Ussher, Annales Veteris Testamenti; creation 4004 BC. Per-verse years via TSK/Theographic.

name: Floyd Nolen Jones (1993)
description: The Chronology of the Old Testament; used for Theographic events.

name: Thiele (1983)
description: E. R. Thiele, The Mysterious Numbers of the Hebrew Kings (3rd ed.); regnal dates with coregencies and rival reigns, the most widely used reconstruction. Double years (716/15) reflect regnal years that straddle two of ours.
citation: Thiele, Mysterious Numbers, 3rd ed. (1983), chronological table p. 217; cross-checked with Wikipedia, 'Kings of Israel and Judah' (rev. 1383533949, CC BY-SA 4.0) and the kings' articles

name: Galil (1996)
description: G. Galil, The Chronology of the Kings of Israel and Judah; a critical reconstruction from the biblical data and Assyrian–Babylonian synchronisms (overlapping reigns are coregencies).
citation: Galil, The Chronology of the Kings of Israel and Judah (Brill, 1996), as tabulated in Wikipedia, 'Kings of Israel and Judah' (rev. 1383533949, CC BY-SA 4.0)

name: Albright (1945)
description: W. F. Albright's regnal chronology, which shortens the reigns to fit Assyrian dates without coregencies.
citation: Albright, 'The Chronology of the Divided Monarchy of Israel', BASOR 100 (1945), as tabulated in Wikipedia, 'Kings of Israel and Judah' (rev. 1383533949, CC BY-SA 4.0)

name: Traditional / internal
description: Dates computed from biblical internal data and traditional authorship (e.g. 1 Kgs 6:1 early Exodus).

name: Scholarly consensus
description: Mainstream modern scholarship; windows reflect the range of published estimates.

name: BTB chronology
description: Era, period and approximate date assigned to each verse by the Bruhman Translator's Bible.

name: Wikidata
description: Dates as recorded in Wikidata statements (P569/P570/P571/P580/P582).

name: Commentaries-Database author years
description: Representative year (usually death or main activity) given for each author by the HistoricalChristianFaith Commentaries-Database.
